field_report: The owner's phone PWA showed (via the v0.4.1 start-up guard): "Uncaught SyntaxError: The requested module './crypto.js' does not provide an export named 'VAULT_VERSION' (settings.js:2)". A new settings.js was combined with a v0.2.x crypto.js from a stale cache. v0.3.0 had removed the ?v= query strings, so the old file and the new file shared one URL; the v0.2.7 service worker had cached exactly that unversioned URL.
changes: All local module, script and stylesheet URLs carry ?v=<release> (scripts/stamp-version.mjs); tests/test-assets.mjs enforces it
Server: versioned .js/.css are public, max-age one year, immutable; unversioned files stay no-cache
Service worker: versioned precache list, best-effort install (one failing asset no longer keeps an old worker in charge), cache-first for versioned URLs, network-first for the rest
verification: Reproduced: with a stale v0.2.7 crypto.js served for /js/crypto.js, v0.4.1 shows exactly the reported error; v0.4.2 starts normally
Application command incl. new tests/test-assets.mjs and server cache-header test
UI walkthrough, accessibility audit, migration e2e, QR scan e2e (48/48) and the v0.2.7 service-worker upgrade simulation passed
compatibility: No data or API change. Rollback: pin v0.4.1 or v0.4.0.
release_step: Run node scripts/stamp-version.mjs <version> before every release tag.
